description: This file defines the PasswordStrengthValidator class, which implements custom password strength validation logic using the ZXCVBN library within a Java-based project. It is part of a validation package and references external ZXCVBN library for quantifying password strength.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthValidator
classes.description: Implements password strength validation logic using ZXCVBN library, based on the PasswordStrengthCheck annotation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the validator with configuration parameters from the PasswordStrengthCheck annotation.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the password by checking if its strength score meets the required threshold.
